summary: Iteration 261 verification (backend + frontend). Backend: new pytest file (15 tests, all pass) covering multi-status SO filter (?status=confirmed,partially_picked,picked → $in, union-equality with single-status queries, whitespace/trailing-comma tolerance, unknown status → [], no _id leak, stats/summary consistency, auth gate), sales-return eligibility endpoint (shape: eligible/window_days/deadline/days_remaining/allowed_return_types, 404 unknown order, 422 missing param, auth gate), and PO list/detail sanity. Frontend (public URL, prebuilt bundle): (1) Keputusan beruntun — approving PO-00007 in 'Semua' tab kept the modal OPEN and loaded the NEXT document (Opname Bandung) with toast 'Lanjut ke ...'; deciding the single item in the 'Pesanan Penjualan' tab closed the modal with 'Antrean saringan ini habis'; notes field resets between documents; list reloads. (2) ReturnEligibilityPanel present on ACTIVE return SRET-00001 with deadline + 'lewat 11 hari' and policy warning (single eligibility API call, 200), ABSENT on settled SRET-00003. (3) Orders pipeline — 7 cards show count + Rp; clicking orders-stat-diproses issued ?status=confirmed,partially_picked,picked, list narrowed 9→3 confirmed rows, active ring applied, KNSelect synced to 'Tahap: Diproses (grup)'; orders-stat-total reset to 9. (4) PO compact panel (409px tall, no long scroll) with supplier/gudang/grand total/lifecycle actions; po-open-full-detail opens po-detail-popup portaled to <body>, closable by Esc and X, containing items+progress, rincian harga & pajak, timeline & document flow; 'Setujui PO' worked from compact panel AND from inside the popup (both 200) and the panel refreshed to the new status/actions. Regression: salesadmin decision modal read-only (no approve button, correct hint), POS 'Semua Filter' modal chips + Terapkan clickable (catalog filtered to 1 produk), peta retur link 'Retur Beli ke supplier' navigates, return stepper visible on detail. Only minor/cosmetic issues found; no blocking bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: After approving level 1 of a 2-level approval chain (PO-00010, Rp 588jt → Manager + Direksi), the green notice/toast says 'PO disetujui. Inbound task dibuat.' although the PO is still waiting_approval and no inbound task was created (approval_chain level 2 pending). Misleading confirmation.
Hint only reads 'Butuh persetujuan peran ADMIN.' with no chain progress; after level 1 the user cannot tell that 1 of 2 levels is done (backend exposes approval_level_current/approval_levels_total).

'Alur Dokumen Terkait' chip still shows WAITING_APPROVAL/AKTIF after the PO was fully approved inside the same popup (flow data not refetched after the lifecycle action); the timeline above it did update.

When the popup is open, data-testid approve-po-button / amend-po-button / cancel-po-button exist twice in the DOM (compact panel + popup) making automated selectors ambiguous; recommend prefixing the popup copies.

issues: Intended stacking z-[120] is overridden by '.modal-overlay { z-index: 60 }' in src/styles/purchasing.css (computed z-index = 60). Visually still on top because the portal appends last, but the documented 'above other layers' guarantee is not actually in effect — use z-[120]! or a dedicated class.
Category/colour/grade chips and the Terapkan/Reset buttons have no data-testid, forcing text-based selectors in tests.

Read-only view shows both 'Detail lengkap tidak dapat dimuat untuk peran Anda' and a red error box 'Anda hanya dapat mengelola pengajuan Anda sendiri' (403 from detail fetch) — noisy for an intentionally read-only state.

action_items: Make the PO approve notice reflect chain progress instead of always 'PO disetujui. Inbound task dibuat.' (use approval_status/approval_level_current from the response).
Show approval-chain level (e.g. 'tingkat 2 dari 2') in POCompactPanel's approval hint.
Refresh the document-flow section inside po-detail-popup after lifecycle actions (currently stale WAITING_APPROVAL chip).
Give the popup copies of lifecycle buttons distinct data-testids to avoid duplicate testids.
Fix DetailPopup z-index: '.modal-overlay' (z-index:60) beats the z-[120] utility.
critical_code_review_comments: ApprovalInbox.onDecided picks the next item from the PRE-reload `filtered` array; when the queue is paginated the next item can be on another page (works today, but note PAGE_SIZE interaction) — behaviour verified correct for current data.
DetailPopup relies on portal DOM order for stacking because its z-[120] class is dead (overridden by .modal-overlay); make the z-index explicit to avoid future overlay regressions.
sales_orders_extra.list_orders comma-status parsing is safe (strips blanks, single value stays scalar) — no injection risk, verified by tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional; 4 minor UI/messaging defects

seed_data_creation: No seed added. Data mutations during testing: PO-00007 approved (approval level via decision popup), SO-0007 'nilai' approval approved, PO-00010 approved through BOTH chain levels (now status=pending/approval_status=approved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four iteration-261 features verified working end-to-end. PO-00010 is now fully approved (status 'pending', inbound stage) — pick another waiting_approval PO (KSC/PO-00011/00013/00014/00015, PO-00009) for future approve tests. Approval inbox 'Semua' had 6-7 pending items after this run; PO-00007 & SO-0007 approvals were consumed. Sidebar groups are collapsed by default for admin: click nav-group-toggle-{group} before nav-{item}. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter261_pipeline_eligibility.py.
rca_of_the_issue: PO approve notice: PurchaseOrderManagement.handleApprovePO sets a fixed success string regardless of the returned approval_chain state, so a partial (level-1-of-2) approval is reported as a completed approval with inbound tasks. DetailPopup z-index: Tailwind's z-[120] utility and the hand-written .modal-overlay rule have equal specificity, and purchasing.css is emitted after the utility layer in the prebuilt bundle, so z-index:60 wins.
